Migration

## Five paths from SDEX to $EV.

If you held SmarDex, you have five ways to move into the new protocol — pick the one that fits your timeframe.

### Stake \[available\]

01

Lock SDEX. Receive $EV over the staking schedule. Get $SDEX to reuse during the second staking phase: Flexible Staking.

### Burn SDEX & Buy EV \[completed\]

02

Burn SDEX in exchange for community sale allocation at preferential terms.

### Use call options 

03

A 10% $EV pool is reserved for SDEX-holder call options at prevailing market price. Proceeds split 50/50 between the DAO treasury and partnerships. Used SDEX is burned.

### Claim the Airdrop

04

Community Airdrop for active and long-term SDEX holders. Manual claim, on-chain only.

### Final SDEX for EV Burn

05

Direct SDEX → $EV at the conversion rate.

Conversion active through 2030. Complete every path to unlock the maximum $EV rewards.

# The full toolkit, carried forward.

Everything inherits the proven SmarDex stack. USDN leads, the rest support.

## Synthetic Dollar  of Everything

A delta-neutral synthetic dollar, backed by ETH, with yield that comes from real protocol activity — staking, funding rates, and liquidation flow.

[See USDN](https://smardex.io/usdn/vault)

### USDN

Yielding

Backed by wstETH collateral and delta-neutral ETH perpetual positions. Rebases. Distributes all surplus yield to holders. 10–20% APY range.

Fully on-chain, decentralized, and permissionless.

### USDnr

Non-rebasing

The non-rebasing version. Yield is redirected to liquidity providers of USDnr-paired pools, creating sustainable depth without artificial incentives.

Yield builds deep, sustainable liquidity.

## Extended Toolkit

Additional on-chain tools built on top of Everything's unified liquidity architecture

### P2P Lending

A fully on-chain peer-to-peer lending system designed for non-dilutive financing.

[Borrow P2P](https://smardex.io/p2p)

### Curated Vaults

Yield strategies built with partners using Everything assets and unified liquidity.

[Earn with vaults](https://app.everything.inc/earn)

### Hybrid Aggregator

A hybrid swap aggregator designed to deliver the best possible execution.

[Hybrid Swap](https://app.everything.inc/swap)
